title: The receipt-conflict dialog queries a column that does not exist, so it can never re-read the server and permanently blocks re-submission
evidence: Wire, captured live: GET /rest/v1/goods_receipts?select=id,status,received_at,created_at,received_by,items:goods_receipt_items(order_item_id,qty_received)&order_id=eq.57367205-9e76-4c32-a5d5-cf6a06f71dd0&order=created_at.desc -> HTTP 400 {"code":"42703","message":"column goods_receipts.created_at does not exist"}. Screenshot out/procurement/ce-01-conflict-dialog.png shows the result: 'חותמת הקבלה בשרת —', 'מי עדכן בשרת —', 'סטטוס הקבלה בשרת —', and the yellow banner 'לא ניתן היה לקרוא מחדש את נתוני ההזמנה מהשרת. ערכים לא ידועים מוצגים כ־—, ושליחה מחדש חסומה עד לקריאה מוצלחת.' The only two buttons are 'סגירה בלי הכרעה' and 'השארת הטיוטה במכשיר'. Source: src/components/ReceiptConflictDialog.tsx:187 selects and orders by goods_receipts.created_at; supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql:174-183 defines goods_receipts with received_at and no created_at, and no later migration adds it. PROVENANCE: git -S dates the created_at reference to commit 02871825 (2026-08-06), so it predates the Wave 0-8 deploy — it is a fresh discovery, not a regression caused by this deploy. It fails 100% of the time for every role, since the column simply is not there.
repro: Sign in as office. Open /receiving, pick an order in status 'נשלחה לספק' (I used #268, order id 57367205-9e76-4c32-a5d5-cf6a06f71dd0). Type a received quantity larger than the outstanding quantity (9 against 3 ordered). Click 'סיום קבלה'. The server refuses with receipt_qty_exceeds_order and the conflict dialog opens; watch the network tab for the 400 on goods_receipts.
expected: The dialog is the product's designated recovery path when the server and the device disagree. It should show what the server actually holds for the order and let the clerk choose per line and resend.
actual: Every server-side field is '—', re-submission is explicitly blocked until a successful re-read that can never happen, and the clerk's only exits are to abandon the decision or leave the draft on the device. The safety net is a permanent no-op.

title: The manual price editor bypasses the 0298 price parser: '12,50' is stored as 1,250.00 ₪, and 1.2345 is silently rounded
evidence: Live, on 'מל+משאבה300סנסס לדיספנסר בק' סבון ידיים 1/6' (פעמית תבניכל שיווק בע"מ, supplier_product 16897474-0a26-4038-9e74-d97e8812a4ac). Typed '12,50' into #price-list-price; the field yields value '1250' (validity.badInput=false, checkValidity()=true). Save sent {"p_price":1250,...} and the server answered 200 {"price": 1250.00, "price_changed": true}. A fresh load of /prices then shows '‏1,250.00 ‏₪ · previous ‏29.00 ‏₪ · ‎+4210.3%' (out/procurement/cm-01-stored.png). Restored to 29.00 immediately afterwards. Two related probes on the same field: '1.2345' was accepted and stored as 1.23 with no notice that rounding occurred; '2000000' was refused server-side with HTTP 400 {"code":"22023","message":"price_values_invalid"} shown to the user as 'המחיר, התאריך או הזמינות אינם תקינים' — one message for three different causes. Source: src/pages/PriceLists.tsx EditPriceModal.save() does `const p = Number(price)` and never calls parsePrice; parsePrice (src/lib/price.ts) is imported by this file but only used by the spreadsheet importer. Migration 0298's own contract states 'a comma is a thousands separator only when it groups in threes, so 1,5 is refused rather than read as 15', and that a rounded value 'says so when rounding changed it'.
repro: Sign in as office. /prices → search a product → row menu → 'עדכון מחיר'. Type 12,50 in 'מחיר חדש', add a reason, Save. Reload /prices and read the stored price.
expected: One parser for a price, as 0298 states. '12,50' is refused (a comma that does not group in threes), a value rounded to the currency's minor units says so, and a value above the 1,000,000 cap is refused as 'above cap' rather than as a lumped 'price/date/availability invalid'.
actual: The two write paths for supplier_products.current_price disagree: the spreadsheet importer refuses '12,50', the manual editor stores 1250. The value flows straight into 'המחיר הנמוך ביותר' comparisons and into purchase_order_items.unit_price on the next order.

title: A received quantity above the outstanding quantity is accepted by the form, labelled 'התקבל מלא', and only refused after 'סיום קבלה'
evidence: out/procurement/pr2-01-over-receipt.png (order #254, line ordered 2, field set to 5) and out/procurement/or-01-over-entered.png (order #268, line ordered 3, field set to 9). In both the quantity input carries max="1000000" (the 0295 magnitude guard) with no per-line bound, the status chip still reads 'התקבל מלא', and the hint beside the field reads 'מלא (2 קרטונים)' / 'מלא (3 ק״ג)' — the label contradicts the number in the field. Only on submit does the server answer HTTP 400 {"code":"22023","message":"receipt_qty_exceeds_order"}. The refusal is correct; the point is that nothing before it is. It then lands in the dialog of PROC-01, which cannot recover.
repro: Sign in as office, open /receiving/57367205-9e76-4c32-a5d5-cf6a06f71dd0 (order #268, 1 line, 3 ק״ג ordered), type 9, press 'סיום קבלה'.
expected: Either the line accepts a surplus and says so (a distinct state, e.g. 'עודף'), or the field is bounded by the outstanding quantity and says why inline — before the clerk finishes a whole multi-line receipt.
actual: The screen shows a green 'received in full' card for a quantity the server will reject, and the rejection arrives only after the clerk has finished counting.

title: The conflict dialog names the wrong cause: it blames another person and an offline device for a quantity the user typed seconds earlier, online
evidence: out/procurement/ce-01-conflict-dialog.png. Server code on the wire: receipt_qty_exceeds_order. Message shown: 'השרת דחה את הקבלה: לפחות שורה אחת חורגת מהכמות שנותרה, או שסטטוס "מלא" אינו שווה בדיוק ליתרה. ייתכן שאדם אחר קלט מהזמנה זו בזמן שהמכשיר היה לא־מקוון. בחר לכל שורה מה נכון — הכמות שנרשמה במכשיר או הכמות שהשרת מכיר — ואל תסמוך על מיזוג אוטומטי: אין כזה.' The session was continuously online (the dialog's own status strip reads 'מחובר לרשת'), the value was typed one second before submit, and no other actor touched the order. The dialog's comparison table already holds the two numbers that make the real cause obvious — 'במכשיר 9' against 'נותר לקבלה: 3'.
expected: When the server code is receipt_qty_exceeds_order and the device is online, say so: this line asks for more than is outstanding. Reserve the offline-race wording for an actual queued-while-offline replay.
actual: A single message covers two very different situations and leads with the one that did not happen, sending the clerk to look for a colleague who never touched the order.

title: The confirmation of the product's central action has no plural form: 'נוצרו 1 הזמנות ספק'
evidence: Toast captured after finalising draft #78 into order #272: 'נוצרו 1 הזמנות ספק'. Source: src/lib/i18n/dictionaries/he.ts:3746 `ordersCreated: 'נוצרו {count} הזמנות ספק'` and en.ts:3736 `'{count} supplier orders were created'`, called from src/pages/neworder/NewOrder.tsx:685. Both locales are wrong for count=1. The same file's neighbours do carry plural pairs (productStep.selectedProductsOne / selectedProductsMany), and the repo has a check:plurals guard which per CLAUDE.md does not run in CI. I could not confirm whether the previous sweep already recorded this.
repro: Create an order for a single supplier through /orders/new and read the toast after 'אשר ושלח הזמנות'.
expected: A singular form for one order, in both locales.
actual: 'נוצרו 1 הזמנות ספק' — plural verb and plural noun with the number 1; English renders '1 supplier orders were created'.

title: A nonexistent order id renders a blank page saying 'contact support'
evidence: out/procurement/cm-03-bad-order-id.png. GET /orders/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 → the REST read returns HTTP 406 (single() over zero rows) and the page renders nothing but a red strip: 'הפעולה נכשלה. אם הבעיה חוזרת — פנה לתמיכה.' No 'order not found', no breadcrumb back to /orders, no other content on the page.
repro: Sign in as office and open /orders/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000.
expected: A record that does not exist (a stale WhatsApp link, a cancelled order) should say so and offer the way back to the list.
actual: A generic failure that names the wrong cause and instructs the user to open a support ticket for a URL that simply has no record behind it.

title: The conflict dialog prints the same explanatory paragraph twice
evidence: out/procurement/ce-01-conflict-dialog.png: the paragraph beginning 'השרת דחה את הקבלה: לפחות שורה אחת חורגת…' appears once as grey body text under the title and again, word for word, inside the red error box directly beneath it. Confirmed in the DOM text dump in out/procurement/conflict-error.json.
repro: As PROC-03; read the top of the dialog.
actual: The same sentence twice, which makes the dialog longer than the screen and pushes the comparison table — the part that carries the information — further down.

title: 'הזמנה חדשה' in the nav resumes an old draft on its confirm step, one click from creating a real supplier order
evidence: out/procurement/neworder-01-step1.png: navigating to /orders/new landed on 'טיוטה #75', last edited 02.09.2026, rendered directly at step 03 'סיכום ואישור' with a live 'אשר ושלח הזמנות' button and a ₪78.70 order ready to be created. Nothing on the screen distinguishes this from a new order except the small line 'טיוטה #75 · נשמר'. /orders itself has a separate 'טיוטה חדשה' button that does create a fresh draft (it navigates to /orders/new?fresh=1).
repro: With at least one saved draft, click 'הזמנה חדשה' in the top navigation.
expected: A link named 'new order' either starts a new order, or resumes a draft with an explicit choice; it should not open a two-day-old draft already at its irreversible last step.
actual: The finalise button for someone else's stale draft is the primary button on a screen reached from a link named 'new order'. The stale-price guard (draft_price_changed) limits the damage but does not prevent an unintended order at unchanged prices.
